questions.q: What is the core structural focus of the 2024 India-UAE Bilateral Investment Treaty (BIT) within India's international investment strategy?
o: Proposes joint sovereign funds and links INR swap with UAE banks.
Focuses on pre-establishment rights and UAE-based arbitration.
Assures post-establishment investor confidence via standard and national treatment.
Aims at GCC-wide tax regulation under India-led digital framework.
questions.s:
The Correct answer is Assures post-establishment investor confidence via standard and national treatment.

Key Points

  • The 2024 India-UAE Bilateral Investment Treaty (BIT) focuses on post-establishment investor rights to ensure investor confidence.
  • Key principles include standard treatment and national treatment, which ensure fair and equitable treatment of investments made by UAE investors in India and vice versa.
  • This treaty aligns with India’s broader international investment strategy, which aims to create an investor-friendly environment while protecting national interests.
  • It ensures that investments will not face arbitrary or discriminatory treatment, thereby promoting a secure investment climate.
  • Such treaties are critical for strengthening bilateral economic ties and increasing foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows between the two nations.
  • The BIT also aims to enhance transparency and provide a structured framework for resolving disputes through mechanisms such as mediation or arbitration.
  • This approach helps in achieving a balance between investor protection and the host country’s regulatory autonomy.

Additional Information

  • Proposes joint sovereign funds and links INR swap with UAE banks
    • This option highlights potential financial mechanisms such as sovereign funds and INR swap arrangements, but these are not the core focus of the BIT.
    • Such mechanisms are often discussed under separate financial agreements or trade pacts, not investment treaties.
  • Focuses on pre-establishment rights and UAE-based arbitration
    • The concept of pre-establishment rights involves granting foreign investors the right to invest even before they establish operations in a host country.
    • However, the 2024 BIT primarily focuses on post-establishment rights, not pre-establishment rights.
    • Additionally, UAE-based arbitration is not a major provision in this treaty; the treaty emphasizes balanced arbitration mechanisms.
  • Aims at GCC-wide tax regulation under India-led digital framework
    • This option refers to potential tax regulations across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), but these are not the objectives of the BIT.
    • Taxation agreements are usually part of separate double taxation avoidance agreements (DTAA) rather than investment treaties.

questions.q: $31 ^ 3 + 18 ^ 3 - 37 ^ 3 + 210$  is equal to:
questions.s:
Given:

$31 ^ 3 + 18 ^ 3 - 37 ^ 3 + 210$

Calculation:

⇒ 313 = 31 × 31 × 31 = 29791

⇒ 183 = 18 × 18 × 18 = 5832

⇒ 373 = 37 × 37 × 37 = 50653

⇒ 313 + 183 - 373 + 210 = 29791 + 5832 - 50653 + 210

⇒ 35623 - 50653 + 210

⇒ -15030 + 210

⇒ -14820

∴ The correct answer is -14820.

Alternate Method

Formula used:

a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a2 + b2 + c2 − ab − bc − ca)

Calculations:

⇒ Let a = 31, b = 18, c = −37

⇒ 313 + 183 − 373

⇒ 313 + 183 + (−37)3

⇒ a + b + c = 31 + 18 − 37 = 12

⇒ ab = 31 × 18 = 558

⇒ bc = 18 × (−37) = −666

⇒ ca = 31 × (−37) = −1147

⇒ a2 = 961, b2 = 324, c2 = 1369

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 = 2654

⇒ ab + bc + ca = 558 − 666 − 1147 = −1255

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 − ab − bc − ca

⇒ = 2654 − (−1255)

⇒ = 3909

⇒ 313 + 183 − 373

⇒ = (12)(3909) + 3(31)(18)(−37)

⇒ = 46908 − 61938

⇒ = −15030

⇒ Add 210

⇒ −15030 + 210 = −14820

∴ The value is −14820.

questions.q: If a + b = 3 and ab = 2, then what is the value of 2a<sup>3</sup> + 2b<sup>3</sup>?
questions.s:
Given

a + b = 3

ab = 2

Concept:

This is the formula to simplify cubic expressions: a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² - ab + b²)

Solution:

2a³ + 2b³ = 2(a³ + b³)

2(a + b)(a² - ab + b²) (Substituting from given)

2(3)(a² - 2 + b²) (as a + b = 3 and ab = 2)

2(3)(a² + b² - 2) (as a² + b² = (a + b)² - 2ab = 9 - 4 = 5)

2(3)(5 - 2) = 2(3)(3) = 18

fore, the value of 2a³ + 2b³ is 18.

questions.q: The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) places emphasis on the use of technology to ensure the authenticity of evidence. This is particularly relevant for:
questions.s:
The correct answer is Digital and electronic evidence.

Key Points

  • The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), or the Indian Evidence Act, emphasizes the importance of using technology to ensure the authenticity and reliability of evidence.
  • It is particularly relevant for digital and electronic evidence, as such evidence can be tampered with or altered without proper mechanisms to ensure its integrity.
  • Digital evidence includes data obtained from electronic devices such as computers, smartphones, hard drives, and cloud-based storage systems. Examples include emails, SMS messages, call logs, and CCTV footage.
  • The Act includes provisions for the admissibility of electronic records under Section 65B of the Indian Evidence Act, 1872, where certified electronic records are treated as evidence in courts.
  • This emphasis on technology aligns with global judicial trends where digital evidence plays a crucial role in solving crimes ranging from cybercrimes to financial fraud and organized crime.

Additional Information

  • Digital and Electronic Evidence:
    • It includes all forms of evidence that are stored or transmitted in a digital format. Examples: emails, social media posts, digital documents, and server logs.
    • Key features: It is highly prone to tampering, requires proper authentication, and necessitates the use of advanced forensic techniques for validation.
    • Under Section 65B of the Indian Evidence Act, electronic records are treated as valid evidence if they meet certain technical criteria, like certification by a responsible official.
  • Physical Exhibits:
    • This refers to tangible objects obtained from crime scenes, such as weapons, clothing, or fingerprints.
    • Physical evidence is crucial but is not typically subject to the same scrutiny as digital evidence in terms of authenticity checks because of its material nature.
  • Hand-Written Diaries:
    • This type of evidence is considered under traditional documentary evidence and does not involve technology for validation.
    • Handwriting experts may be used for authentication.
  • Oral Confessions:
    • These are verbal statements made by a suspect or accused during interrogation.
    • Such evidence is admissible under Indian law but must be corroborated with other evidence to ensure reliability.
  • Admissibility of Digital Evidence Globally:
    • The United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) has emphasized the importance of digital evidence in combating transnational crimes.
    • Countries like the USA and the UK also have laws in place, such as the Federal Rules of Evidence in the USA, that govern the admissibility of digital evidence.

Important Points

  • Section 65B Certification: A certificate is required for the admissibility of electronic records, which ensures that the evidence was generated and stored in a reliable manner.
  • Electronic Evidence Forensics: Advanced forensic tools are used to extract and analyze data while maintaining its integrity.
  • Challenges: The dynamic nature of digital evidence, jurisdictional issues (e.g., data stored overseas), and encryption can complicate its use in legal proceedings.
  • Role in Modern Crimes: Digital evidence is indispensable in solving cybercrimes, financial fraud, and even traditional crimes where technology plays a role, such as using CCTV footage in robbery cases.
  • Judicial Precedents: Indian courts have increasingly relied on digital evidence, with landmark cases such as Anvar P.V. v. P.K. Basheer (2014) setting important precedents for admissibility.

questions.q: If a number is divided by a divisor D leaves remainder 17. If the number 3N is divided by D leaves a remainder 5. Find the remainder when 4N is divided by D?
questions.s:
Answer is 22.
Dekh bhai... Agar $N$ par remainder 17 hai, toh $3N$ par theoretically $3 \times 17 = 51$ hona chahiye. Par question kehta hai 5 bacha. Matlab $(51 - 5) = 46$ divisor $D$ ka multiple hai. Since remainder 17 tha, $D > 17$ hoga. $46$ ke factors hain 23, 46. So $D$ is purely $23$ or $46$. Ab $4N$ par aate hain, $4 \times 17 = 68$. Agar usko $D$ se divide kare (say 23), toh $68 = 23 \times 2 + 22$. Remainder hamesha 22 aayega. Mast concept!

questions.q:
Rearrange the following sentences in correct order to make a logical passage:

1. A media strategy was framed based on outreach results.

2. Demographic metrics were tracked from campaign dashboards.

3. User interactions were collected across platforms.

4. Analysts segmented users by age and behavior.
questions.s:
The correct answer is Option 1.
 
Key Points
  • The passage follows a logical progression of a data-driven marketing workflow, starting from data gathering and ending with strategic implementation.
  • Sentence 3 is the first sentence as it establishes the initial step of the process: data collection.
    • "User interactions were collected across platforms."
  • Sentence 2 follows as it describes how the collected data is monitored and organized for visibility:
    • "Demographic metrics were tracked from campaign dashboards."
  • Sentence 4 is the third sentence because it represents the analytical phase where the tracked data is categorized into meaningful groups:
    • "Analysts segmented users by age and behavior."
  • Sentence 1 is the final sentence as it provides the conclusion—using those analytical insights to create an actionable plan:
    • "A media strategy was framed based on outreach results."
  • The correct sequence is 3-2-4-1.
 
Coherent paragraph after rearrangement:
"User interactions were collected across platforms. Demographic metrics were tracked from campaign dashboards. Analysts segmented users by age and behavior. A media strategy was framed based on outreach results."

questions_hin.q_hi: The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) places emphasis on the use of technology to ensure the authenticity of evidence. This is particularly relevant for:
questions_hin.s_hi:
The correct answer is Digital and electronic evidence.

Key Points

  • The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), or the Indian Evidence Act, emphasizes the importance of using technology to ensure the authenticity and reliability of evidence.
  • It is particularly relevant for digital and electronic evidence, as such evidence can be tampered with or altered without proper mechanisms to ensure its integrity.
  • Digital evidence includes data obtained from electronic devices such as computers, smartphones, hard drives, and cloud-based storage systems. Examples include emails, SMS messages, call logs, and CCTV footage.
  • The Act includes provisions for the admissibility of electronic records under Section 65B of the Indian Evidence Act, 1872, where certified electronic records are treated as evidence in courts.
  • This emphasis on technology aligns with global judicial trends where digital evidence plays a crucial role in solving crimes ranging from cybercrimes to financial fraud and organized crime.

Additional Information

  • Digital and Electronic Evidence:
    • It includes all forms of evidence that are stored or transmitted in a digital format. Examples: emails, social media posts, digital documents, and server logs.
    • Key features: It is highly prone to tampering, requires proper authentication, and necessitates the use of advanced forensic techniques for validation.
    • Under Section 65B of the Indian Evidence Act, electronic records are treated as valid evidence if they meet certain technical criteria, like certification by a responsible official.
  • Physical Exhibits:
    • This refers to tangible objects obtained from crime scenes, such as weapons, clothing, or fingerprints.
    • Physical evidence is crucial but is not typically subject to the same scrutiny as digital evidence in terms of authenticity checks because of its material nature.
  • Hand-Written Diaries:
    • This type of evidence is considered under traditional documentary evidence and does not involve technology for validation.
    • Handwriting experts may be used for authentication.
  • Oral Confessions:
    • These are verbal statements made by a suspect or accused during interrogation.
    • Such evidence is admissible under Indian law but must be corroborated with other evidence to ensure reliability.
  • Admissibility of Digital Evidence Globally:
    • The United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) has emphasized the importance of digital evidence in combating transnational crimes.
    • Countries like the USA and the UK also have laws in place, such as the Federal Rules of Evidence in the USA, that govern the admissibility of digital evidence.

Important Points

  • Section 65B Certification: A certificate is required for the admissibility of electronic records, which ensures that the evidence was generated and stored in a reliable manner.
  • Electronic Evidence Forensics: Advanced forensic tools are used to extract and analyze data while maintaining its integrity.
  • Challenges: The dynamic nature of digital evidence, jurisdictional issues (e.g., data stored overseas), and encryption can complicate its use in legal proceedings.
  • Role in Modern Crimes: Digital evidence is indispensable in solving cybercrimes, financial fraud, and even traditional crimes where technology plays a role, such as using CCTV footage in robbery cases.
  • Judicial Precedents: Indian courts have increasingly relied on digital evidence, with landmark cases such as Anvar P.V. v. P.K. Basheer (2014) setting important precedents for admissibility.

questions_hin.q_hi: If a number is divided by a divisor D leaves remainder 17. If the number 3N is divided by D leaves a remainder 5. Find the remainder when 4N is divided by D?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Answer is 22.
Dekh bhai... Agar $N$ par remainder 17 hai, toh $3N$ par theoretically $3 \times 17 = 51$ hona chahiye. Par question kehta hai 5 bacha. Matlab $(51 - 5) = 46$ divisor $D$ ka multiple hai. Since remainder 17 tha, $D > 17$ hoga. $46$ ke factors hain 23, 46. So $D$ is purely $23$ or $46$. Ab $4N$ par aate hain, $4 \times 17 = 68$. Agar usko $D$ se divide kare (say 23), toh $68 = 23 \times 2 + 22$. Remainder hamesha 22 aayega. Mast concept!

questions_hin.q_hi: The number of adults who come only to walk in a park every day is 140. 18% of the adults come only to accompany their children in the park. 54% of the adults come only to run in the park. What is the total number of adults who come to the park every day [if the adults come for no other activity other than for the given reasons]?
o_hi:
700

    560

    400    

    500
700
questions_hin.s_hi:
Solution
Let total adults = 100
18 + 54 = 72
Remaining = 28 for walk
28→140
1→5
Total =5×100=500

questions_hin.q_hi:
Rearrange the following sentences in correct order to make a logical passage:

1. A media strategy was framed based on outreach results.

2. Demographic metrics were tracked from campaign dashboards.

3. User interactions were collected across platforms.

4. Analysts segmented users by age and behavior.
questions_hin.s_hi:
The correct answer is Option 1.
 
Key Points
  • The passage follows a logical progression of a data-driven marketing workflow, starting from data gathering and ending with strategic implementation.
  • Sentence 3 is the first sentence as it establishes the initial step of the process: data collection.
    • "User interactions were collected across platforms."
  • Sentence 2 follows as it describes how the collected data is monitored and organized for visibility:
    • "Demographic metrics were tracked from campaign dashboards."
  • Sentence 4 is the third sentence because it represents the analytical phase where the tracked data is categorized into meaningful groups:
    • "Analysts segmented users by age and behavior."
  • Sentence 1 is the final sentence as it provides the conclusion—using those analytical insights to create an actionable plan:
    • "A media strategy was framed based on outreach results."
  • The correct sequence is 3-2-4-1.
 
Coherent paragraph after rearrangement:
"User interactions were collected across platforms. Demographic metrics were tracked from campaign dashboards. Analysts segmented users by age and behavior. A media strategy was framed based on outreach results."

questions_hin.q_hi: 12. रूमी अपनी आय के 20% की बचत किया करती थी। यदि उसकी आय में 30% की वृद्धि हुई और उसके खर्च में 40% की वृद्धि हुई। तो उसकी नाममात्र बचत में ₹750 की कमी आई। रूमी की प्रारंभिक आय (₹ में) ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions_hin.s_hi:
12.(b)

आय = व्यय + बचत

प्रारंभिक :- 100 = 80 + 20

अंतिम : - 130 = 112 + 18

बचत में परिवर्तन (2%) = 750 ₹

प्रारंभिक आय (100%) = 750  × 50 = 37500 ₹

questions_hin.q_hi: If it is 3:00 PM at a location on 45° West longitude, what would be the time at the Prime Meridian (0° longitude)? / यदि 45° पश्चिम देशांतर पर स्थित किसी स्थान पर दोपहर के 3:00 बजे हैं, तो प्रधान मध्याह्न रेखा (0° देशांतर) पर क्या समय होगा?
questions_hin.s_hi: Moving east, time increases. 45 degrees equals 3 hours (45/15), so 3:00 PM + 3 hours = 6:00 PM.

It powerfully and gracefully empties its massive sediment load directly into the vast Bay of Bengal. / शानदार गंगा-ब्रह्मपुत्र डेल्टा, जिसे दुनिया भर में राजसी सुंदरबन डेल्टा या विशाल बंगाल डेल्टा के रूप में भी जाना जाता है, को दुनिया में कहीं भी पूर्ण सबसे बड़े नदी डेल्टा के रूप में विश्व स्तर पर स्पष्ट रूप से और आधिकारिक तौर पर मान्यता प्राप्त है। यह शक्तिशाली और शान से अपने विशाल तलछट भार को सीधे विशाल बंगाल की खाड़ी में खाली कर देता है।

questions_hin.q_hi: 14. यदि एक बेलन के वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल में 20% की वृद्धि कर दी जाए और उसकी ऊंचाई में 4% की कमी कर दी जाए, तो उसके आयतन में निवल कमी या वृद्धि कितनी होगी?
questions_hin.s_hi:
14.(c)

बेलन  का  वक्र  पृष्ठीय  क्षेत्रफल = 2πrh माना ,  त्रिज्या x%  बढ़  जाती  है , तब x-4-4x100=20 24x25=24 x=25  बेलन  का  आयतन= πr2h 25 और  25  का  शुद्ध % परिवर्तन= 25 +25+25 × 25100= 56.25 56.25  और (-4) का  शुद्ध  %  परिवर्तन=56.25- 4-56.25 × 4100=52.25-2.25 = 50% आयतन  में  वृद्धि।
